description: Gambia, The Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Economics and prices", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Data for medium and high voltage transmission lines in Gambia, The. The data were compiled for the AICD study led by the World Bank. A variety of sources were consulted, including regional power pool documents and maps from World Bank project documents. Coverage: the whole world. It has 2 files in ZIP, XML. The portal files it under Economics and prices. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
